description:
FOUND s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 12:41) from s513g's final report: "The blessed board baseline itself is stale against main (40 NEW / 74 FIXED when the tree is compared to it directly). That is why base vs tree is the comparison I report."  Every batch since some point has compared base-extraction vs tree (correct) while the blessed file drifted: 74 rows that now pass were never edited out with their fixing batch, and 40 rows now failing were never added with a cause.  RECIPE (#223, s341): one run on a clean main checkout, then EDIT the file row by row -- each FIXED row leaves citing the batch that fixed it (bisect by `git log -S` on the test name or by the batch reports in docs/session-log.md), each NEW row is added with its cause task (or a new task), never re-blessed from the run; `# taken-at:` stamp.  Owner: an Opus filler (half a session).  Until then every board claim is base-vs-tree only.

=== DONE (s515c) ===
Measured on main's code 973bdb1d (the shared base result base/973bdb1d for 13 dists + Scalar-List-Utils alone WITH --no-dist-lib): 5 NEW / 46 FIXED against the blessed file.  The s513g "40 NEW / 74 FIXED" was mostly the scratch board.sh running Scalar-List-Utils WITHOUT --no-dist-lib since s513 (38 files, 0 rows: the dist's XS lib/ shadows PCL's must-win shim): 36 NEW / 15 FIXED of it.  Edited row by row (commit 357b1fde): 46 FIXED keys (58 rows) LEFT with their windows in the header (Capture-Tiny's 10 tied rows = s514d #2590; Class-Inspector 54 = s514f #3140; the rest before s514, families named from the session log); 5 NEW rows ENTERED with causes (Data-Dump quote.t #2066, Role-Tiny role-basic-composition.t #3001, Try-Tiny finally.t 10-12: since s499j a -I copy wins over a non-must-win shim, so the dist's own Try::Tiny runs and its finally blocks need scope-exit DESTROY, #2370 PARKED); `# taken-at: 973bdb1d 2026-10-11`.  Bar: --diff of the main measurement against the edited file = 0 NEW / 0 FIXED / 0 LOST.
Scalar-List-Utils: without --no-dist-lib 38 FAIL / 0 rows; with it 20 PASS / 15 PARTIAL / 3 FAIL, 492 ok / 49 not ok -- the flag is the board's setting (it always was in the blessed command; only the scratch copy lost it).
The population is now VERSIONED: baselines/cpan-board-dists.tsv, read by tools/cpan-board.sh TREE OUTPREFIX (the scratch board.sh becomes a one-line wrapper at merge time).
Also measured: passing rows LOST against cpan-board14-s474.tsv (not rows of the blessed file): Try-Tiny context.t 25 -> 13 and finally.t 29 -> 11 (the s499j cause), Role-Tiny load-module.t 1 -> 0 (#1970's SBCL note has no newline and run-dist-t merges stderr into the TAP).
